correctness.rationale: The explicit 9-coordinate E6 root model has 36 representative vectors of integer squared length 18; an exhaustive exact-integer 36x36 enumeration proves A^2=8I-2A+12J and S^2=20I+8S. Those identities give signed eigenvalues 10 (multiplicity 6), -2 (30), and nonorthogonality graph eigenvalues 20 (1), 2 (20), -4 (15). The Gegenbauer addition theorem with parameter 2 produces all eigenlevels, with k=0..4 ranks 1,6,20,30,35. The exact C_k^(2)(1/2) six-residue formula and C_k^(2)(0) expression prove strict positivity for every odd k>=5 and even k>=10, while k=6,8 are checked exactly. At k=10 the eigenvalues 18/143,144/143,150/143 imply condition number 25/3; decreasing explicit tail bounds imply a strictly smaller ratio at every other k>=5. The bundled checker reproduces exhaustive finite identities and 40 exact rational sample degrees; a separate numerical eigensystem cross-check agrees. No finite enumeration is used to infer an infinite claim.

evidence: The 240-point E8 root result evaluates Gegenbauer C_k^(3) on S^7 and classifies 120 antipodal pairs; the 126-point E7 root result evaluates C_k^(5/2) on S^6 and classifies 63 antipodal pairs.

The present intrinsic E6 sampling uses C_k^(2) on S^5 and 36 antipodal pairs. Root-set containment in an ambient root system does not identify same-degree intrinsic harmonic restrictions or their singular values.

originality.rationale: The exact-degree, all-degree root evaluation Gram spectrum and unique sharp condition-number resonance at k=10 were compared at statement and implication level with the harmonic-index design papers (arXiv:1308.5101 and arXiv:1507.05373) and Borodachov 2022 section 9 (arXiv:2212.04594). The known five-design property gives constant-sector zeros at degrees two and four but neither the other eigenspaces nor the all-degree interpolation and sharp stability conclusion. The explicit E6 association graph provides a powerful standard input; prior coverage of the completed spectral and extremal theorem was not identified, with a residual association-scheme literature risk.

value.rationale: The E6 root configuration is a canonical exceptional spherical five-design, and exact-degree harmonic sampling and robust interpolation are intrinsic, motivated invariants of that configuration. The theorem gives a complete rather than arbitrarily sliced rank classification, identifies the sharp interpolation threshold and the unique k=10 worst stability resonance despite full rank. The uniform optimal 25/3 Gram conditioning quantifies a natural precision cost for arbitrary high-frequency harmonic interpolation on these 36 antipodal classes. It is structurally distinct from the already-known constant-weight five-design cancellations and requires an all-degree positivity and extremization argument.
